lines.en: I move along the tree shadows, sideways on.
My claws touch down almost silently.
Step by step I circle behind you.
My long tail balances me.
I keep to the outermost ring.
My feathers flatten in the wind.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方草都伏下去。
lines.en: The grass lies down where I pass.
I do not charge straight; I circle.
My steps are lighter than they look.
I approach low and do not raise my head.
Each step is hunting an angle.
I pace a full circle along the fence.
I slow down on purpose to put you at ease.
I snap a dry branch on purpose.
I crouch with my head low.
My tail tip twitches.
I wait for you to turn your back.
My pupils narrow to slits.
I neither blink nor move.

lines.zh: 命我培育我的人要我快。
lines.en: Those who bred me wanted speed.
I count how often you turn.
The air is thick with green smells.
My spine curves into an arc.
I wait for the wind to change.
My claws spread slightly.
I dislike how bright it is here.
I shift my weight slowly forward.

lines.zh: 围栏那边有我不敢碰的东西。
lines.en: Beyond the fence lies something I dare not touch.

lines.zh: 我从背后来的，这不算偷袭。
lines.en: I came from behind; that's not ambush.

lines.zh: 我盯着你脖子上的脉搏。
lines.en: I watch the pulse at your throat.
You are taller, but not faster.
I prefer to begin from behind.
You hold your breath, but your shoulders move.
Do not turn your back to me.

lines.zh: 我是被做出来的，不是生出来的。
lines.en: I was made, not born.
Your footsteps are too regular.

lines.zh: 我数过了，你每九步回一次头。
lines.en: I counted: you look back every nine steps.
Did you see my plumage?

lines.zh: 我抬头只是让你以为我要冲。
lines.en: When I raise my head, it is to make you think I charge.

lines.zh: 你已经在原地站太久了。
lines.en: You have stood too long in one spot.
I hiss and slide back half a step.
Blood mats my feathers.

lines.zh: 我扭身，把伤处护在里面。
lines.en: I twist to keep the wound inward.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我绕后的步子。
lines.en: That broke my circling stride.
I growl deep in my throat.
My left leg buckles; I shift my weight.
Watching you, I retreat to the tree shadow.
My breath caught for a moment.
My claws gouge deep lines in the soil.

lines.zh: 混种的身手，居然被你碰到。
lines.en: A hybrid's footwork — and you touched it.
You hold it out before you.
I know the smell of meat.
I go around, not straight to it.
Keep that hand steady. I will notice.
Put the meat down and back off three steps.

lines.zh: 混种的本能，让我先闻闻。
lines.en: Hybrid instinct says sniff first.

lines.zh: 这一口不会让我慢下来。
lines.en: A bite of this will not slow me.

lines.zh: 你退的时候看了我一眼。
lines.en: You glanced at me as you retreated.
Good. That was clever of you.
I took it without touching your fingers.
You struck my shoulder.
I turned sideways to shed the force.
We each step back half a pace.
My feathers are knocked up.
My claws slip on the ground.
That was a solid hit.

lines.zh: 撞上来的东西，我低吼警告。
lines.en: I growl a warning at whatever hit me.

lines.zh: 你的手臂碰到我的牙了。
lines.en: Your arm brushed my teeth.
I changed position at once.

lines.zh: 这下你知道我在旁边了。
lines.en: Now you know I am beside you.
I accept what you brought.

lines.zh: 我们分工，你正面，我后面。
lines.en: Let us split it: you take the front, I take the rear.
I dislike running side by side.
You are fast, but you turn slowly.

lines.zh: 我们一起把它逼到角落。
lines.en: Together we drive it into the corner.
When I call, you go in.
We take opposite sides of the fence.
You watch the front for me.
I am trusting you with my back.
Do not look back while you run.
I lower my head and snatch it up, quickly.
This can be swallowed, but it is not good.
I wedge it under the roots and cover it with soil.

lines.zh: 我用前爪把它拨了个面。
lines.en: I flip it over with a foreclaw.
This will not quiet hunger.
It is still warm.
I carry it off first, then look it over.
You dropped this. I picked it up.
I lower myself to reach it.
A claw print is left on the ground.
You walked away. That is enough.
I come from your left.
The gap at your back is perfect.

lines.zh: 我被造出来，只为从背后下手。
lines.en: I was made to strike from behind.
My target is always the back.
The grass rustled and you did not hear.
This time I need not circle long.
You will not reach the ninth step.
I have been on your right for a while.
That thing in your hand is too slow.

lines.zh: 你的后颈，是我的第一目标。
lines.en: The nape of your neck is my first mark.

lines.zh: 羽毛竖起来了，就是信号。
lines.en: My feathers rising is the signal.
Run — the hunt has only begun.
This bite is not meant to miss.
I match every step you take.
You look back, and I drop low.
I close half a foot at a time.
Your shadow lies ahead of me.
I wait for your ninth step.

lines.zh: 风把我身上的气味吹散了。
lines.en: The wind has scattered my scent.
You drift right, and I circle right.
My tail lies flat against the grass.
Your breathing has quickened.
Within two steps, you can't turn in time.
There is a wall in front of you.
I am lowering myself.
You stopped. So did I.
This angle from behind is just right.
Now — this step.
I spring from behind.
Claws first, teeth after.
My sickle claw cuts into your shoulder.
I have knocked you down.
You rolled fast; I pulled back.
That only tore cloth.
I land and rise at once.
I have your bracer in my teeth.

lines.zh: 你踢中我的肋，我松了口。
lines.en: You kicked my ribs and I let go.
I loop half around and come back.
Blood shows clearly on the grass.
I held nothing back there.
I am crouching low again.

lines.zh: 挨了这一爪还站着，意外。
lines.en: Still standing after that claw — surprising.
There is one more shadow in the enclosure.
I come from the direction of the breeding tanks.
There is still damp on my feathers.
This is not where I was born.

lines.zh: 笼门一开，我就到了这儿。
lines.en: The cage door opened, and here I am.

lines.zh: 我先绕着围栏走了一圈。
lines.en: First I paced one circuit of the fence.
The grass parts before me.
I raise my head and scent your position.
The trees beyond the fence are tall.

lines.zh: 我的影子比身子长出两倍。
lines.en: My shadow is twice as long as my body.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有别的脚步。
lines.en: I hear other footsteps in the distance.

lines.zh: 我慢慢从树影里走出来。
lines.en: I step slowly out of the tree shadow.

lines.zh: 培育我的人要的是速度。
lines.en: Speed is what my makers wanted.
When I landed, the grass made no sound.
I settle, my tail swaying slowly.
The smells here are unfamiliar.
First I looked over the ways out.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候我已经在了。
lines.en: When you looked up, I was already here.

lines.zh: 羽毛烧起来，我打了个滚。
lines.en: My feathers catch fire and I roll.
One leg gave when I landed.

lines.zh: 水没过头，我的爪子抓不住。
lines.en: Water closes over me and my claws find nothing.
The blast throws me into the bushes.
I strike best from behind.

lines.zh: 一股冷意从骨头里烧起来。
lines.en: A cold fire burns up from my bones.

lines.zh: 围栏里没剩下什么能吃的。
lines.en: There is little left to eat in this enclosure.
Lightning flashes and my whole body seizes.
There is nothing at all beneath me.
